manual.title: Drive cartridge
manual.body: Start with FA-513 (motor) beside preparation C. Place it in the fixture, seat FA-514 on its flange, then fit four W-12 washers and four H-12040 screws in the upper holes.

manual.title: Coupling & bearing
manual.body: Fit FA-515 on the already fitted FA-514 output shaft. Position FA-522 in the preparation fixture; the fixture supports the exposed drive while you assemble it. Leave FA-515 unclamped.

manual.title: Lead screw
manual.body: Carry FA-516 (lead screw) from its shelf into the already fitted FA-522 bearing and FA-515 coupling. Clamp FA-515 with two W-12 washers and two H-12030 screws.

manual.title: Retain the shaft
manual.body: Seat FA-523 against the already fitted FA-522 bearing. Fit the FA-524 receiver collar half and clearance collar half around the shaft. Fit two W-12 washers and H-12030 screws through the clearance half into the receiver half.

manual.title: Travelling nut
manual.body: Fit FA-517 (travelling nut) onto the already fitted FA-516 lead screw.

manual.title: Output rod
manual.body: Carry FA-518 (output rod) from its shelf. Join it to the already fitted FA-517 travelling nut with two W-12 washers and two H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Enclose the drive
manual.body: Fit FA-510 around the exposed drive held by the preparation fixture. From the open rear end, secure the already fitted FA-513 motor with four W-12 and H-12040 pairs. Secure the already fitted FA-523 retainer from outside the housing with two more pairs.

manual.title: Guide key
manual.body: Engage FA-521 (guide key) in the longitudinal slot of the already fitted FA-518 rod. Its offset ears attach to the FA-510 housing with two W-12 washers and two H-12030 screws; the rod slides along the key.

manual.title: End sensors
manual.body: Seat both FA-528 probes in the FA-510 openings. Each external mounting flange takes W-12 and H-12030. Fit FA-530 in the round barrel port.

manual.title: Front guide & seals
manual.body: Slide FA-519 along the already fitted FA-518 rod into the FA-510 front shoulder. Place FA-520 on the rod. Fit the FA-529 rear cap gasket, with its extra clearance holes, at the motor end; fit the front cap gasket at the rod end.

manual.title: Close the housing
manual.body: Fit one FA-511 (front cap) and one FA-512 (rear cap). Secure each cap with four W-12 washers and four H-12050 screws.

manual.title: Base eye
manual.body: Fit FA-525 (base eye housing), one FA-526 spherical eye bearing, then one FA-527 eye retaining ring. Secure the housing with two W-12 washers and H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Rod eye
manual.body: Fit FA-525 (rod eye housing), one FA-526 spherical eye bearing, then one FA-527 eye retaining ring. Secure the housing with two W-12 washers and H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Ready to install
manual.body: FA-500-P is ready after all 91 pieces. Open the parent foot manual for installation.

manual.title: Foot workshop
manual.body: Prepare both FA-302 heel pads and FA-500-P (pitch actuator). Use the foot bay controls to expose each side. Follow each branch to install and secure it before transferring the foot.

manual.title: Heel position 1
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). Stock the hardware from its drawers and select the matching pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Heel position 2
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). Stock the hardware from its drawers and select the matching pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Cradle clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (cradle clevis) from its shelf and fit it to FA-103. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Ring clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (ring clevis) from its shelf and fit it to FA-200. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Seat & pin actuator
manual.body: Carry the prepared FA-500-P and seat it here. At each end fit FA-221 (pin), FA-222 (keeper), W-12, then H-12030. The FA-500-P child manual covers its preparation.
